title: Number of Longest Increasing Subsequence
goal: Count the longest strictly increasing subsequences by index choices.
strategy: For each ending position track both the best length and its number of constructions. A better length replaces the count; an equal length adds ways.

phasePurposes.start: Count the longest strictly increasing subsequences by index choices.

phasePurposes.done: Count the longest strictly increasing subsequences by index choices.
